exact_claim: Theorem 4.5 transfers SNN's entry-wise finite-sample bound to MSNN under Assumptions 2.1 through 4.3, and Theorem 4.6 gives the displayed asymptotic N(0,1) limit under its four additional side conditions; Remark 4.7 says both have the same form as SNN after replacing AR/AC by MAR/MAC.
falsification_rule: FALSIFIED if one explicit asymptotic sequence satisfies the coherent intended MSNN assumptions and every displayed theorem side condition, but the Theorem 4.5 right-hand side tends to zero while the estimation error does not, and the Theorem 4.6 standardized statistic does not converge to N(0,1).
non_circularity: The sequence is analytical and fixed before calibration: N=t^4, K=t, rank one, anchor loading N^-1, donor-row factors (1,N^-2,...,N^-2), target loadings one, and fixed Gaussian noise. No sample size, tolerance, or horizon was selected from an observed fit.
